title: Create exact PDF page geometry
description: Convert millimetres to PDF points only inside the renderer boundary and create explicit page boxes that match the selected normalized sheet dimensions.
acceptanceCriteria: The renderer documents and uses exactly 72 PDF points per inch and 25.4 millimetres per inch
Millimetre-to-point conversion occurs only at the PDF adapter boundary
MediaBox and any intentionally set page boxes equal normalized sheet width and height within renderer precision
Scene coordinates use one documented origin and axis transform into PDF coordinates
No browser default paper size, orientation, margins, scaling, or print CSS determines page geometry
A parsed artifact check verifies page count and page boxes

steps.details: Define the conversion constant `points = millimetres * 72 / 25.4`, numeric precision policy, scene origin, PDF origin, and y-axis transform in the renderer module.
Construct each PDF page with width and height converted from validated normalized sheet geometry; set page boxes explicitly where supported by the selected library.
Map millimetre scene bounds and text origins to PDF points using the documented axis transform and optional compatible whole-sheet translation at this boundary only.
Generate a one-page fixture, parse its page dictionary with an independent inspection path, and assert page count and boxes match expected converted dimensions.

technicalNotes: PDF page geometry is software evidence and does not prove physical output scale.
Keep conversion out of reusable geometry and printable-scene modules.
